{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Interceptor''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] that served with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Warship/Legends|warship]] engaged and attacked the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Radley]]'', which had been waiting to rendezvous with the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Cathleen]]''. When the cruiser arrived, it launched [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]], which successfully overwhelmed the defenses of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], resulting in its destruction.
